LightningComponentBundle.description: Lets a sales rep select child accounts to move to Nurturing when closing an opportunity as lost.

property.name: masterAccountId
property.label: Master Account Id
property.description: Id of the parent account whose direct children are listed.

property.name: selectedAccountIds
property.label: Selected Account Ids
property.description: Ids of the child accounts selected by the user.

property.name: selectedCount
property.label: Selected Count
property.description: Number of child accounts selected by the user.
